dedupe_keys.name: matrikkelen bygningspunkt building points from norway s cadastre kartverket

description: Matrikkelen - Bygningspunkt is an open extract of the building information in the Matrikkel, Norway's official register of real property including buildings, published by Kartverket through Geonorge. Each building is a representation point with its building type, building number and current status, identifiers for linking (local id or UUID), the address and property identifiers taken from the unit records in the cadastre, and the SEFRAK identifier where one exists. Coverage: all current buildings in Norway; demolished buildings and building changes such as extensions are left out. Access: free download without login as national, county or municipal files in FGDB, GML, PostGIS and SOSI, a WFS with about 15 minutes delay, daily municipal files and weekly county and national files, plus a separate set of historical versions. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: it is a small subset of the register, with no footprints, floor areas or construction years; outlines and more detail are in FKB-Bygning, which is limited to Norge digitalt parties and sold to private users through resellers. Simulation uses are a national building location and type layer for exposure models, emergency planning and digital twins, linkable to addresses and properties. Related records: the Danish BBR and Swiss GWR building registers, and the Riksantikvaren heritage buildings record.
